exposure: Presence of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in human milk
outcome: Presence of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in human milk
Presence of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in infant throat swab samples
cohort: The study included 15 mothers diagnosed with COVID-19 and their infants.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 RNA was detected in human milk from 4 of 15 mothers with COVID-19, and their infants subsequently tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 RNA; additionally, 6 of 12 breastfed infants overall tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 RNA with mild symptoms.
